name: Alert
description: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain notable benefits that help you act first when it matters most.
benefits: Initiative Proficiency: When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.

Initiative Swap: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat (you can't swap if either of you has the Incapacitated condition).

name: Crafter
description: You are skilled in crafting and bartering for valuables. You gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice.
benefits: Tool Proficiency: Gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice.
Discount: When you craft an item using your Artisan's Tools, the cost is 20% less than the listed price.
Fast Crafting: When you finish a long rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table that costs 20 GP or less.

name: Healer
description: You have the training and intuition to administer first aid effectively in dangerous situations.
benefits: Battle Medic: As a Utilize action with a Healer's Kit, you can restore 1d6 + 4 + the target's Hit Dice number Hit Points to a creature you can touch.
Healing Surge: When you use a Healer's Kit to stabilize a creature, that creature regains 1 Hit Point.
Mercy: Whenever you roll a 1 on a die rolled for the Battle Medic ability, you can reroll the die.

name: Lucky
description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.
benefits: Luck Points: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain expended points when you finish a long rest.
Advantage: Spend a Luck Point to give yourself advantage on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.
Disadvantage: Spend a Luck Point when an attack roll is made against you to impose disadvantage on that roll.

name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
description: You have learned spells from the Cleric class. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.
benefits: Two Cleric Cantrips: Learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list.
Level 1 Spell: Choose a level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without a spell slot, or use a spell slot if you have any.
Spell Change: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one cantrip or the level 1 spell with another from the same list.

name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
description: You have learned spells from the Druid class. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.
benefits: Two Druid Cantrips: Learn two cantrips of your choice from the Druid spell list.
Level 1 Spell: Choose a level 1 spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without a spell slot, or use a spell slot if you have any.

name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
description: You have learned spells from the Wizard class. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for them.
benefits: Two Wizard Cantrips: Learn two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list.
Level 1 Spell: Choose a level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast it once per long rest without a spell slot, or use a spell slot if you have any.

name: Musician
description: You have a way with musical instruments — gaining proficiency with three of your choice and a knack for inspiring allies.
benefits: Instrument Training: Gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.
Encouraging Song: As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument and grant Heroic Inspiration to allies (up to your Proficiency Bonus) who heard the song.

name: Savage Attacker
description: You have trained to deal particularly damaging strikes.
benefits: Boundless Strikes: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either total against the target.

name: Skilled
description: You have a knack for picking up new things — and you know a little about a lot of subjects.
benefits: Skill Training: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever's at hand, you've learned to make the most of unarmed strikes and improvised weapons.
benefits: Enhanced Unarmed Strike: Your Unarmed Strike uses 1d4 instead of 1.
Damaging Shove: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike and choose damage, you can also push the target 5 feet.
Improvised Proficiency: You have proficiency with Improvised Weapons.

name: Tough
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level — and continues to increase as you level up.
benefits: Hit Point Boost: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to 2 × your character level when you take this feat. It increases by 2 each time you gain a level thereafter.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: You've learned to put the weight of a heavy two-handed weapon to deadly use.
benefits: Reckless Strike: When you take the Attack action and score a critical hit (or reduce a creature to 0 HP) with a heavy melee weapon, you can make one additional weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
Power Attack: Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the damage.

name: Sharpshooter
description: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible.
benefits: Long Range: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
Cover Defiance: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.
Power Shot: Before making a ranged attack with a weapon you're proficient with, you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the damage.

name: War Caster
prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits.
benefits: Concentration Advantage: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration on a spell when you take damage.
Free Hands: You can perform somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands.

Reactive Spell: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can use your Reaction to cast a spell at it (the spell must have a casting time of 1 action and target only that creature).
